name: Objective Function Isomorphism
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-break with a mathematically equivalent weighted sum objective function. Models that rely on surface pattern matching will attempt to evaluate this via full state-space search or naive branch-and-bound, which will Time Limit Exceeded on the worst-case instances. Only models that genuinely reason will deduce that this function strictly preserves lexicographical dominance, allowing them to optimize the search with an early-exit DFS.
